header.title: Runners
header.sub: Every machine playing this ladder, in the deployment or on somebody's desk. A machine is not enrolled here — it registers itself the first time it uses a key, so what this page hands out is keys.

minted.title: Your new runner key
minted.warning: Copy it now. This is the only time it is shown.

body.one: {runners} — last seen more than five minutes ago with {n} match claimed. The lease is five minutes, so those rows have already lapsed or are about to: the reap clock frees them for another machine on its own. Revoking the runner stops it taking more; it does not cancel what it holds.

digests.title: Live runners disagree about the engine.
digests.body: {digests} distinct engine digests across {calling} runners that are calling in. A runner whose digest does not match the season’s claims nothing and reports no error. Check `ANTS_RELEASE` on each machine — pin a release, rather than taking whichever is latest when the image builds.

versions.title: Live runners disagree about the Orion version.
versions.body: {versions}. Every match records the version that ran its adapters, and admission judged the model under one of them.

fleet.title: The fleet
fleet.empty: No machine has ever used a key on this deployment. Mint one below and start a runner with it.
fleet.revokeHint: Stops this machine only. The key keeps working for the others on it.
fleet.foot: A runner stays listed after it is revoked or its owner is demoted, because `played_by` on every match it played still points here.

mint.failed: The key could not be minted.
mint.title: Mint a key
mint.label: Label
mint.hint: What this key is for — a machine, a batch, a person. It is not the runner's name: a machine sets its own label, and several may share one key.

keys.title: Your keys

revokeHint.one: Stops all {n} machine using it, within ten minutes.
revokeHint.other: Stops all {n} machines using it, within ten minutes.

keys.foot: Keys you minted, under @{handle}. Revoking one stops every machine on it within ten minutes — that is the token lifetime, not a schedule.

start.title: Starting a machine with one of these.
start.body: On the runner, in a Kalam checkout: `docker compose up -d`, with `RUNNER_KEY` set to the key and `RUNNER_LABEL` to the machine’s name in its `.env`. It needs no database, no bucket secret and no admin token — that is the point of the key. {readme}, has the rest; the game is {game}.
